name: Traefik
tagline: Cloud-native Networking Stack That Just Works.
description: Cloud-Native Networking Stack That Just Works.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
services:
  app:
    image: traefik:v3.7.16
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      PUID: $PUID
      PGID: $PGID
      TZ: $TZ
      TRAEFIK_API: false
      TRAEFIK_API_DASHBOARD: true
      TRAEFIK_API_INSECURE: false
    ports:
      - target: 80
        published: 48102
        protocol: tcp
      - target: 443
        published: 48103
        protocol: tcp
      - target: 8080
        published: "${APP_PORT}"
        protocol: tcp
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/traefik.toml
        target: /etc/traefik/traefik.toml
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/traefik.yml
        target: /etc/traefik/traefik.yml
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/config.yml
        target: /etc/traefik/config.yml
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/acme.json
        target: /etc/traefik/acme.json
      - type: bind
        source: /var/run/docker.sock
        target: /var/run/docker.sock
